[[File:Akazake_Kumamoto.JPG|right|thumb|240x240px|Kumamoto Akazake]]

'''{{nihongo|2=灰持酒|3=Akumochizake}}''' (also written as '''{{nihongo|2=灰汁持ち酒}}''') is a type of [[sake]] in which [[ash]] is mixed into the [[brewing]] mash.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=The History of Sake in Kumamoto ｜KUMAMOTO SHUZO KUMIAI |url=https://www.kumamoto-sake.com/english/material/history.html |access-date=2023-03-09 |website=www.kumamoto-sake.com}}</ref> It is drunk as a New Year spiced sake.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tsukeage Kagoshima prefecture {{!}} Our Regional Cuisines : MAFF |url=https://www.maff.go.jp/e/policies/market/k_ryouri/search_menu/menu/tsukeage_kago_shima.html |access-date=2023-03-09 |website=www.maff.go.jp}}</ref>
